ai: Skiing is very popular in Japan during the winter.
滑雪在日本冬天非常受歡迎。
She went skiing with her cousins over the holiday.
她假期和表兄弟姊妹去滑雪。
My brother broke his leg while skiing last year.
我哥哥去年滑雪時摔斷了腿。
He was unaware that the meeting had been cancelled.
他不知道會議已經被取消了。
Many people are unaware of how much sugar is in soda.
很多人不知道汽水裡有多少糖。
She walked past, completely unaware of the danger ahead.
她走了過去，完全沒察覺前方的危險。
The nurse treated every patient with kindness and compassion.
那位護理師以善意與同情心對待每一位病人。
He felt great compassion for the lost child.
他對那個迷路的孩子充滿同情。
Teachers need patience and compassion to work with young children.
老師需要耐心與同理心才能和小孩相處。
She always wears fashionable clothes to the office.
她總是穿著時髦的衣服上班。
This neighborhood has become a fashionable place to live.
這個社區已經變成一個時髦的居住地點。
Short hair is very fashionable this year.
短髮今年非常流行。
The whole congregation stood up and sang together.
全體會眾一起站起來唱歌。
Our congregation has grown a lot in the past five years.
我們的會眾在過去五年成長了很多。
A large congregation of birds gathered by the lake.
一大群鳥聚集在湖邊。
The congregation of fans outside the stadium blocked the road.
體育場外聚集的球迷擋住了道路。
The judge showed mercy because it was his first mistake.
法官因為這是他的初犯而從輕發落。
They begged the king for mercy.
他們向國王求饒。
She has no mercy when she plays chess.
她下棋時毫不留情。
It was a mercy that no one was hurt in the storm.
暴風雨中沒有人受傷，真是萬幸。
We are grateful for small mercies on a hard day.
在艱難的一天裡，我們對小小的幸運心懷感激。

mercy.zh: 任憑擺布、受制於（at the mercy of）
ai: The small boat was at the mercy of the waves.
那艘小船任由海浪擺布。
Farmers are often at the mercy of the weather.
農民常常得看天吃飯。
She sings beautifully, and everyone loves her voice.
她唱得很好聽，大家都喜歡她的聲音。
The room was beautifully decorated for the party.
房間為了派對布置得很漂亮。
The sun set beautifully over the sea.
夕陽在海面上美麗地落下。
The new system works beautifully so far.
新系統到目前為止運作得非常順利。
Everything went beautifully at the wedding.
婚禮上一切都進行得非常順利。
The bird pulled a worm out of the wet soil.
那隻鳥從潮濕的土裡拉出一條蟲。
After the rain, worms came out onto the sidewalk.
下雨後，蚯蚓爬到了人行道上。
He put a worm on the hook and cast his line.
他把一條蟲掛在魚鉤上，然後甩出釣線。
The child wormed through the crowd to get to the front.
那個孩子在人群中鑽到前面去。
He wormed his way under the fence.
他慢慢鑽過了圍籬下方。
The legendary hero is said to have defeated a dragon.
傳說中的英雄據說打敗過一條龍。
Locals still tell legendary stories about the old mountain.
當地人仍然流傳著關於那座老山的傳說。
He is a legendary coach who has won many championships.
他是一位贏得許多冠軍的傳奇教練。
The restaurant is legendary for its beef noodle soup.
這家餐廳的牛肉麵非常有名。
Her patience with students is legendary.
她對學生的耐心是出了名的。
